recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. It restores the FHIR-32069 code-system/value-set split in an active example and removes the only remaining current source use of the obsolete resource-types code-system URL.
issue_request: FHIR-32069 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to remove abstract Resource and DomainResource style codes from ResourceType, ensuring concrete-only resource-type bindings for affected artifacts while preserving separate abstract-inclusive type sets where needed.
initial_application: Commit e7b4eba11e applied the issue by introducing CodeSystem/fhir-types, ValueSet/resource-types as the concrete subset, all-resource-types for abstract-inclusive uses, and related binding/example updates. Later commit 3d15d8f10d reworked Consent.provision.resourceType and reintroduced the stale http://hl7.org/fhir/resource-types Coding.system in the SMART-on-FHIR Consent example.
additional_context: Current terminology source defines ResourceType as Concrete FHIR Resource Types drawn from http://hl7.org/fhir/fhir-types. Consent is active in source/fhir.ini, the SMART-on-FHIR example is listed in source/consent/list-Consent-examples.xml, and Consent.provision.resourceType binds to ValueSet/resource-types. Searches found no active CodeSystem/resource-types definition and no conflicting Zulip evidence; FHIR-I minutes corroborate the Jira scope and approval.
reconciliation: Changed source/consent/consent-example-smartonfhir.xml so the MedicationRequest resourceType coding uses http://hl7.org/fhir/fhir-types instead of http://hl7.org/fhir/resource-types.
source_changes: source/consent/consent-example-smartonfhir.xml: changed Consent.provision.resourceType Coding.system from http://hl7.org/fhir/resource-types to http://hl7.org/fhir/fhir-types.

related_jiras.note: Found in Jira/source searches as a later interface-behavior issue touching fhir-types terminology, but it does not alter the FHIR-32069 code-system/value-set split.
